import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem continuous_preimage_finite_common_pointwise_order_closed
  {β X ι : Type} [TopologicalSpace β] [TopologicalSpace X]
  (h : β → X) (hh : Continuous h)
  (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
  (f g : ι → X → ℝ)
  (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
  (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i)) :
  IsClosed (h ⁻¹' {x : X | ∀ i ∈ s, f i x ≤ g i x}) := by
  classical
  have hclosed_set : IsClosed {x : X | ∀ i ∈ s, f i x ≤ g i x} := by
    refine s.induction_on ?h0 ?hstep
    · simpa using isClosed_univ
    · intro a s ha hs
      have hclosed_a : IsClosed {x : X | f a x ≤ g a x} :=
        isClosed_le (hf a) (hg a)
      have hclosed_s : IsClosed {x : X | ∀ i ∈ s, f i x ≤ g i x} := hs
      have hset :
          {x : X | ∀ i ∈ insert a s, f i x ≤ g i x} =
            {x : X | f a x ≤ g a x} ∩ {x : X | ∀ i ∈ s, f i x ≤ g i x} := by
        ext x; constructor
        · intro hx
          have h1 : f a x ≤ g a x := hx a (by simp [Finset.mem_insert])
          have h2 : ∀ i ∈ s, f i x ≤ g i x := by
            intro i hi
            exact hx i (by simp [Finset.mem_insert, hi])
          exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · intro hx
          rcases hx with ⟨h1, h2⟩
          intro i hi
          have hmem : i = a ∨ i ∈ s := by
            have : i ∈ insert a s := hi
            simpa [Finset.mem_insert] using this
          rcases hmem with h_eq | h_in
          · simpa [h_eq] using h1
          · exact h2 i h_in
      have hclosed_inter :
          IsClosed ({x : X | f a x ≤ g a x} ∩ {x : X | ∀ i ∈ s, f i x ≤ g i x}) :=
        hclosed_a.inter hclosed_s
      simpa [hset] using hclosed_inter
  exact hclosed_set.preimage hh
